appearance_facts.location: upper-left quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: The light orange slice labeled 'Apple' occupies the largest angular extent of any sector, spanning approximately from the 12 o'clock position to the 9 o'clock position.

appearance_facts.location: lower-left quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: The medium orange slice labeled 'Xiaomi' is the second-largest sector, spanning approximately from the 9 o'clock position to the 6 o'clock position.

appearance_facts.location: lower-right quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: The pale yellow slice labeled 'Samsung' is the third-largest sector, spanning approximately from the 6 o'clock position to the 4 o'clock position.

appearance_facts.location: upper-right quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: The dark red slice labeled 'Others' is the smallest sector, spanning approximately from the 4 o'clock position to the 12 o'clock position.
